messages:
Priya: Quick sync we need cross-team alignment on the 'prefill-stitch' pilot. Goal: 2k rps steady at ~250ms p95, handle 5k rps bursts for ~15m. Need prefill window, reserved burst plan, KMS requirements, and rollback criteria. cc @Ethan @Maya @Leo @Sam @Anika
Ethan: For latency stability I prefer reserved prefill slots + KV prefix warming. Autoscale alone is risky for p95.
Maya: Runtime asks: 10m prefill window, prefix list of ~60 hot prefixes, KV warm + synthetic prompts for early validation. Need a fallback model id (quantized) and canary routing.
Leo: Infra can reserve a small burst pool (2-3 nodes). Scheduler needs 48h notice and exact vGPU counts. If KMS is required, open ticket now so rotation windows can be planned.
Sam: Security: KMS + audit logs is OK. Request: short threat-model session (30-45m) and an IaC policy PR for key roles. Confirm telemetry strips PII.
Anika: PM note: customers expect a documented quality/latency tradeoff for fallback. I'll draft a short one-pager. Also we need rollback triggers product approves.
Ethan: Proposed rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 5m OR p95 >450ms for 5m OR semantic-match drop >5% -> rollback. Thoughts?
Maya: Agree. Will add observability alerts for those and a synthetic prompt set. Also will expose a per-tenant canary flag: example config -> ```json
{"canary":{"type":"percent","value":5},"fallback":"redwood-small-q8"}
```
Leo: I'll create reservation request tonight. Planning 2x burst nodes + autoscale grace 20m. Will post reservation id when approved.
Priya: Actions: Priya -> open KMS ticket (#TICKET-5xxx) and own customer comms; Ethan -> add canary flag + doc fallback behavior by Tue; Maya -> publish prefix list + attach eval prompts; Leo -> submit reservation with node counts; Sam -> schedule threat-model within 48h; Anika -> draft customer-facing fallback doc.
infra-bot: reservation submitted: req-87234; ETA approval 2024-06-13T09:00Z
Priya: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD Ill lock scope and kick off tickets.
